name: @geastack/android
description: Native Android build target for GeaStack apps: compiles apps to native code and renders them with real Android views, no WebView, without Gradle.

scripts.test: for f in $(git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)(test[-_][^/]*|[^/]*\.test)\.mjs$'); do echo "==> $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
